title: TACZ Gun buff
description: Turn Gunsmith Lib attributes into potion effects for better map making.
body:
### ⚠️ Dependency Requirement
This mod requires **[Gunsmith Lib](https://www.curseforge.com/minecraft/mc-mods/gunsmith-lib)** to function properly.


这个mod需要**[Gunsmith Lib](https://www.curseforge.com/minecraft/mc-mods/gunsmith-lib)**)才能正常工作。


---




### 💡 About This Mod###💡关于这个Mod
This mod converts the weapon attribute system from Gunsmith Lib into standard potion effects. By turning these technical attributes into tangible status effects, it makes balancing, triggering, and managing gun buffs significantly easier and more flexible for custom map making.


这个mod将武器属性系统从Gunsmith Lib转换为标准药水效果。通过将这些技术属性转化为有形的状态效果，它使平衡、触发和管理枪支buff变得更加容易和灵活。
